name: mimic-jmp-phase0-spike
description: Phase 0 technical validation spike for mimic-JMP. S1: webR boots and runs R under Node/Windows. S2/S3: DOE package chain + design matrices via pre-bundled WASM R packages mounted with NODEFS (zero runtime network). S4: qcc control charts with independent control-limit recomputation. S6: AlgDesign D/I-optimal designs and design-to-model closed loop.

scripts.verify: npm run lock:check && node scripts/s1_webr_boot.mjs && node scripts/s2_nodefs.mjs && node scripts/s4_qcc.mjs && node scripts/s6_algdesign.mjs
